security_spec.violation_condition: In XiangShan RTL, when Zama16b is advertised in the ISA but the Load-Store Unit (LSU) or PMA checker does not enforce MAG16 atomicity boundaries for misaligned loads, stores, and AMOs targeting main memory regions: specifically, if a misaligned access whose bytes all lie within a naturally-aligned 16-byte granule is split into multiple micro-operations observable by other harts or DMA engines, or if such an access incorrectly raises an address-misaligned exception, the hardware violates the norm:pma_mag_zama16b_req requirement.
security_spec.summary: Zama16b mandates MAG16 (16-byte misaligned atomicity granule) for main memory — the LSU must not tear misaligned accesses contained within a 16-byte aligned region, or lock-free concurrent algorithms relying on this atomicity guarantee will observe torn reads/writes, causing silent data corruption in multi-hart scenarios
